title: Fixed residue basis lifts to every power quotient of a flat algebra
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal n, and let C be a flat A-algebra [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For any index set X, any A/n-basis b of C/nC, and any family x : X -> C whose residue classes equal b, every positive integer r admits an A/n^r-basis of C/(n^r C) whose value at each i is the class of x(i). No Noetherianity, finite generation, or finiteness of X is assumed.

source.place: Tag 07QM(4), proof, applying Algebra Tags 00HI and 051F to a flat algebra and fixed residue-basis lifts

proof.text: Write n = maximalIdeal A, I = n^r, R = A/I, M = C/(I C), N = C/nC. Positivity of r gives I <= n, hence I is proper and R is a nontrivial local ring. By map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective, maximalIdeal R = n.map (Quotient.mk I). Ideal.map_pow and map_quotient_self show its r-th power is zero.

Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor identifies M with R tensor_A C as an R-module. Module.Flat.baseChange makes that tensor product flat; Flat.of_linearEquiv transfers flatness to M. This is the quotient-ring version of tensoring with A/I and flat base change.

Let m = maximalIdeal R and Q = m times M. The third isomorphism theorem and the maximal-ideal equality give ek : R/m isomorphic to A/n. Give N its R-action via A/I -> C/nC and its R/m-action via ek. Quotient.factor gives a surjective R-linear f : M -> N. Ideal.smul_top_eq_map, the equality of the structural-map composites, Ideal.map_map and Quotient.factor_ker identify ker f with Q. The first isomorphism theorem therefore gives an R-linear M/Q -> N equivalence; extend scalars through the surjection R -> R/m to obtain an R/m-linear equivalence. Basis.mapCoeffs along ek.symm changes the scalar ring of the supplied basis b, without changing its vectors. Transport it backwards through the equivalence. Its vectors are the classes of the fixed lifts x, since the quotient factor map sends each class of x to its original residue class.

Apply basis_iff_basisQuotient_of_nilpotent to the flat R-module M, the nilpotence proved in step 1, and the family of classes of x in M. The transported residue basis from step 3 supplies its left-hand side, and its right-hand side is exactly the asserted basis of M over A/n^r with the prescribed values.

A flat algebra over a local ring has bases modulo every power of the maximal ideal on fixed lifts of a residue basis
mathlib_searches.results: Found exists_basis_of_span_of_flat, exists_basis_of_basis_baseChange and IsLocalRing.basisQuotient; these impose finite presentation or finite free hypotheses, absent here. No exact match.

mathlib_searches.query: basis.*quotient|basis.*nilpotent|strict.?hensel in Mathlib and lean/WeilConjectures and lean/Sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib LocalRing/Quotient has finite free basisQuotient; LocalRing/Module has finite presentation lifting results. Sheaf BasisIffBasisQuotientOfNilpotent supplies the needed generic nilpotent criterion, but no generic power-quotient version. The original strict-henselization quotient-bases theorem is the only fixed-all-powers version and has a sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem flatAlgebra_power_basis
    (A : Type u) (C : Type v) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Module.Flat A C]
    {X : Type w}
    (b : Module.Basis X (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
      (C ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C)))
    (x : X → C)
    (hx : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C)) (x i) = b i)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    ∃ b' : Module.Basis X (A ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ^ r)
      (C ⧸ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ^ r).map (algebraMap A C)),
      ∀ i, b' i = Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ^ r).map (algebraMap A C)) (x i)
